about.text: Japan’s “fresh cream”: what the milk ordinance calls cream, at least 18 % fat with nothing added. Cream with emulsifiers, stabilisers or vegetable fat in it is not cream there, and much of what is sold for whipping is.

sources.text: The photograph, its author and its licence, from its page.

how.text: Cream with fat set to the grade and nothing added; sold chilled in 200 ml cartons.
